headings.usage: Headings, massive text, stylized numbers, buttons.

rules: Headings must use sentence case, never all caps unless it's a tiny label.
Use extremely tight line-heights (leading-none) for massive headings.
Apply line-by-line overflow hidden text reveal animations for big headers.

visual_enhancers.cards: Subtle border (1px solid var(--color-cloud-grey)), background var(--color-warm-white) or white. VERY subtle or NO shadow. Rounded-2xl.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use borders for structure (Swiss-style thin lines) instead of drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Use circular framed images or rounded pill badges for categories.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid heavy gradients. If teal is used, make it flat or a very subtle radial blur behind elements.
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: Deliberate spotlights, clipped frames (rounded-2xl with overflow-hidden). Images in portfolio should have a 1px border.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous whitespace. Use py-24 to py-32 for section vertical padding. Use gap-8 or gap-12 in grids.
grids_and_layouts.portfolio_grid: Bento or asymmetric masonry grid. Mix col-span-1 and col-span-2 layouts to create tension. Never perfectly symmetrical.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Opt for left-aligned text for paragraphs and headings, except in specialized central manifestos.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal: Wrap lines in overflow-hidden divs, translate Y from 100% to 0% with Framer Motion (ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1], duration: 1).
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform for subtle Y-axis shifts on images as the user scrolls.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for services. react-fast-marquee at speed 30. Use Manrope, transparent text with 1px text-stroke in Cadet Blue, or solid Deep Charcoal.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Portfolio cards: image scales up (scale-105) over 0.6s ease-out. Text remains static or arrow icon translates X.

component_specs.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), Manrope SemiBold. Primary: Deep Charcoal bg, Warm White text. Hover: Cadet Blue bg.
component_specs.navigation: Fixed or sticky header. MUST HAVE SOLID OR BLURRED BACKGROUND. Do not use fully transparent header. bg-[#F7F9F8]/90 backdrop-blur-md.
component_specs.contact_form: Minimalist inputs. border-b only (border-cloud-grey), no background. Focus: border-cadet-blue. Select dropdown for 5 service categories.
component_specs.footer: Midnight Slate background. Warm White text. Massive typography for 'SB Creatives'.

Home.Hero: Kinetic typography, minimal imagery. Huge text 'Crafting Modern Brands'. Line-by-line reveal.
Home.Marquee: Edge-to-edge slow marquee of service categories.
Home.Selected_Work: Asymmetric bento grid (col-span-12, varying sizes) of top 4 projects. Real photography.
Home.Manifesto_Preview: Numbered layout (01, 02, 03) highlighting approach. High contrast.
Home.CTA: Dark section (Midnight Slate) with massive link to contact.

Services.Layout: List-based or accordion-style deep dive into the 5 categories (Brand & Creative, Digital & Web, etc.). Accompany with sleek icon or subtle circular image for each.

Work.Layout: Full grid of case studies. Filterable by category. Subtle parallax on scroll.

About.Layout: The Manifesto. Numbered chapters. Typography heavy. Generous whitespace, photos of the agency or abstract creative moments.

Contact.Layout: Split screen. Left: Huge text 'Let's Talk', contact info (hello@sbcreatives.in). Right: Minimalist form with Select for service.

media_and_3d.photography_style: Real product photography treated deliberately. Use clipped frames and spotlight effects. Do not use generic corporate stock.
media_and_3d.3d_moments: Subtle 3D hero moment or floating elements (react-three-fiber or purely css/framer-motion parallax) to elevate the 'creative' vibe.

portfolio.project: Al Hilal x PUMA / NOX Dubai

accessibility.guidelines: Ensure high contrast. Use semantic HTML. Support keyboard navigation.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='nav-home'`, `data-testid='portfolio-card-1'`, `data-testid='submit-btn'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components and views are implemented using Javascript (.js or .jsx), NOT Typescript, as this is a JS codebase.
Setup Tailwind CSS with the specified custom color variables in tailwind.config.js.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in a top-level wrapper component.
Implement Framer Motion for the kinetic line-by-line reveal on the Hero sections.
Use react-fast-marquee for the text marquee.
Build the 5 pages (Home, Services, Work, About, Contact) using React Router.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds on headers. Use backdrop-blur with a solid fallback color (like bg-[#F7F9F8]/90).
Ensure the contact form contains a Select dropdown for the 5 service categories. Create a lightweight FastAPI backend for this form and connect it.

Do NOT use raw HTML elements for complex interactive parts; customize Shadcn UI components (like Select, Form, etc.) but strip out any generic 'Vercel-look' styling to match the agency's premium minimal aesthetic.
universal_guidelines: Never use generic AI-generated aesthetic (no blue gradients, centered boring layouts).
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-12, p-24) than feels comfortable.
Include data-testid on every interactive element.
